pkgmetadata.longdescription: agent-workspace-linux is a Model Context Protocol server that gives an agent a private X11 desktop to work in. Each workspace is a separate Xvfb display with a window manager, a control socket and a floating viewer, so apps launched into it do not attach to the user session. The server observes a workspace through screenshots and window listing, drives it with synthetic input, and can run a browser against an isolated profile. An optional permission ceiling restricts network access, mounts and launched programs, and is enforced with bubblewrap when it is available.

agent-workspace-linux 是一个 Model Context Protocol 服务程序，为智能体提供 一个私有的 X11 桌面。每个工作区是一套独立的 Xvfb 显示、窗口管理器、控制 socket 和浮动查看器，因此其中启动的程序不会接入用户的会话。服务程序通过 截图和窗口列表观察工作区，用合成输入驱动它，并能以隔离的配置文件运行浏览器。 可选的权限上限用于限制网络访问、挂载和可启动的程序，在 bubblewrap 可用时 由其强制执行。
